description: Implementation of HttpServerPropertiesManager class for managing HTTP server properties, including reading/writing preferences, parsing server info, alternative services, and handling broken services in Chromium project.

classes.name: HttpServerPropertiesManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP server properties including loading/saving preferences, parsing server info, handling alternative services, and broken services management.

methods.name: HttpServerPropertiesManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manager with preferences delegate, callback, limits, log, and clock.

methods.name: ReadPrefs
methods.description: Reads server properties, quic info, broken services from preferences.

methods.name: AddToBrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Adds broken or recently broken alternative services from preferences.

methods.name: AddServerData
methods.description: Parses and adds server info from preferences.

methods.name: ParseAlternativeServiceInfoDictOfServer
methods.description: Parses alternative service info for a server.

methods.name: ParseAlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Parses alternative service info for a server.

methods.name: ReadLastLocalAddressWhenQuicWorked
methods.description: Reads last local address used when QUIC worked from preferences.

methods.name: ParseNetworkStats
methods.description: Parses network stats for a server.

methods.name: AddToQuicServerInfoMap
methods.description: Adds QUIC server info from preferences.

methods.name: WriteToPrefs
methods.description: Serializes and writes server info, QUIC info, broken services to preferences.

methods.name: SaveLastLocalAddressWhenQuicWorkedToPrefs
methods.description: Saves last local address used for QUIC to preferences.

methods.name: SaveQuicServerInfoMapToServerPrefs
methods.description: Saves QUIC server info map to preferences.

methods.name: SaveBrokenAlternativeServicesToPrefs
methods.description: Saves broken and recently broken alternative services to preferences.

methods.name: OnHttpServerPropertiesLoaded
methods.description: Callback when preferences are loaded, triggers parsing and callback.
